subject: Reserved commit term & ramp plan — SolarBridge Dedicated capacity
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda@solarbridge.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated reserved commit options + proposed ramp

Amanda —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, I put together three reserved-commit options for SolarBridge's Dedicated GPU pool along with suggested ramp windows so you can compare unit economics and risk. High level: all options include SLA-backed availability, throughput guarantees per committed vGPU equivalent, and regional placement in us-west-2.

Attachments: SB-Dedicated-PRICING-v3.pdf (detailed line items)

Quick summary (numbers are monthly committed spend, not seat counts):
- Option A — 12-month: smaller upfront, 10% discount on list, start window 8 weeks from signature, 4-week linear ramp to target throughput
- Option B — 24-month (recommended): 18% discount, start window 6 weeks, 6-week ramp with guaranteed minimum throughput at week 2
- Option C — 36-month: 24% discount, start window 4–6 weeks, accelerated 3-week ramp + extended price protection on model swaps

Questions for you so we can lock a final offer:
1) Do you need a hard committed start date (legal) or a soft "start window" is acceptable?
2) Any preferences on which weeks we guarantee minimum throughput during ramp (week 1 vs week 2)?
3) Will procurement require a PO before signature or after countersignature?

If helpful I can propose a phased capacity-onboard plan that stages a subset of the pool earlier to support demos while the full pool is provisioning.

Next steps: if you confirm preferred term and the start-window expectation, I'll loop in Laura for final pricing and Vanessa for onboarding timeline.

—Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Amanda Lee <amanda@solarbridge.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated reserved commit options + proposed ramp

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear options. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement prefers to issue a PO after contract signature but needs a signed MSA before issuing.
- We can accept a soft start window but need a committed minimum throughput from day 14 of onboarding for critical billing pipelines.
- We are strongly leaning to the 24-month path for predictability but I'd like to see a slightly more aggressive start/ramp for the first 2 months to get our ML batch jobs stable.

Also, can you confirm whether the discount tiers are stackable with an early-pay (annual prepay) option? If so, what does that do to the effective price?

I'll loop Chris (CPO) and procurement on follow-up.

Thanks — Amanda
Head of ML Platforms | SolarBridge
amanda@solarbridge.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda@solarbridge.ai>, Chris Park <chris.park@solarbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated reserved commit options + proposed ramp — pricing & prepay question

Laura / Vanessa —

Amanda confirmed a preference for 24 months, wants a committed minimum throughput by day 14, and asks whether prepay stacks with the 18% 24-month discount. Procurement will issue a PO after the signed MSA.

Can you please:
- Confirm whether we can guarantee the requested min throughput at day 14 and what the SLA language should look like.
- Provide a revised pricing schedule showing 24-month 18% commit + annual prepay (Net 0 on month after signature) and the effective blended rate.
- Flag any provisioning risks for a ~6-week start window and an aggressive first 8-week ramp.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated reserved commit options + proposed ramp — pricing & prepay question

Rafael —

We can do the throughput guarantee at day 14 with the following guardrails:
- Guarantee applies to committed vGPU equivalent throughput at >=70% of target starting day 14; full target guaranteed at day 42.
- SLA credits begin if availability < 99.5% across the committed pool for two consecutive 7-day windows.

Pricing notes:
- Base 24-month commit: 18% off list.
- Annual prepay (full year up front): additional 4% effective discount (i.e., stackable).
- Early-bird signature credit: we can apply a one-time $25k onboarding credit if they sign within 10 business days of proposal.

I attached a quick pricing worksheet and a sample SLA excerpt.
Attachments: SB-Dedicated-PRICING-v3.pdf

Provisioning risks: usual items — GPU allocation depends on region inventory, and we may need a short burst-capacity reservation during initial weeks which we can offer as a paid optional add-on. With a 6-week start window we are comfortable delivering the pool in us-west-2.

If SolarBridge wants an accelerated 3-week ramp to reach case-specific throughput we should budget a small phi-burst (extra capacity for weeks 1–3) — happy to price that line separately.

—Laura
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda@solarbridge.ai>, Chris Park <chris.park@solarbridge.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, procurement@solarbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal update — 24-month + stacked prepay + accelerated ramp option

Amanda / Chris —

Thanks for the quick answers. Based on Laura's inputs we put together a final commercial proposal:
- Term: 24 months (SB-2026-019)
- Commitment: $180k/month list before discounts (committed vGPU equivalents)
- Discounts: 18% commit + 4% annual prepay = effective 21.28% (applied to list)
- Onboarding credit: $25k if signed within 10 business days
- Start window: target start 2026-12-15, acceptable window 2026-12-08 to 2026-12-22
- Ramp: week-by-week plan
  * Week 0–1: Provision baseline pool for dev & demos (25% throughput)
  * Week 2: Guarantee minimum throughput at >=70% (per SLA)
  * Week 3–6: Linear ramp to 100% target throughput (full guarantee at day 42)
- Optional accelerated ramp (weeks 1–3) available for a one-time fee of $45k to reserve burst capacity and priority placement.

Next steps: please confirm (a) term and (b) whether you want to prepay year 1 (we'll issue an invoice) and (c) whether you want the accelerated ramp add-on. Once confirmed we will circulate the MSA and SOW for signature and Laura will attach the SLA excerpt.

Thanks — Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Amanda Lee <amanda@solarbridge.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Chris Park <chris.park@solarbridge.ai>, procurement@solarbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal update — 24-month + stacked prepay + accelerated ramp option

Rafael / Laura / Vanessa —

We appreciate the fast turn. SolarBridge is prepared to go with the 24-month commitment and will prepay year 1 to capture the stackable discount. We also want the accelerated ramp add-on to ensure our pipelines are stable within 3 weeks.

Action items from our side: procurement will send the PO to procurement@redwood.ai after we receive the signed MSA. Chris will review the SOW and SLA excerpt today. Expect PO within 48–72 hours of signed agreement.

Please proceed to send the countersigned MSA + SOW. We will route the invoice for the year-1 prepay to our finance team once we receive the final contract.

Thanks — Amanda
Head of ML Platforms | SolarBridge
amanda@solarbridge.ai
